H01.description: When build.chunkImportMap is enabled but getImportMap returns undefined (no import map asset in the bundle), the non-null assertion lets head dereference importMap.mapping and crash instead of skipping import-map handling.

I01.description: Snapshot update after a rolldown dependency bump changed sourcemap output; not a defect in the change.

I02.description: With chunk import maps, the preload dependencies a chunk resolves through the import map are not included in that chunk's hash, so preload changes can leave the hash unchanged and serve stale cached chunks; exact head lines are not shown, so the anchors point at the import-map handling region.
